description:
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Dance of the Dead until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Dance of the Dead triggers, causing you to sacrifice Abdel Adrian.
Dance of the Dead returns to the battlefield, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
Repeat from step 2.
